question: What are the expense rules for attending an overseas conference, covering both travel and registration costs?
expected_answer: Travel (FIN-EXP-001): business class permitted for international flights over 6 hours with VP approval; economy otherwise. Hotel up to USD 280/night (developed countries). Training (FIN-EXP-003): conference registration counts toward the annual budget. Employees may attend up to 2 external conferences per year. Conferences with registration fees over USD 1,000 require a written summary shared with the team within 30 days of return.

question: If a role requires specialist software and training on that software, what approval processes apply?
expected_answer: Software (IT-PROC-002): must be requested through IT; IT Security team reviews within 5 business days; CISO sign-off required for exceptions not in the Approved Software Catalogue. Training (FIN-EXP-003): expenses above USD 500 require manager approval before purchase; above USD 1,500 require manager and department head approval.

question: What annual leave and sick leave policies apply during an employee's notice period?
expected_answer: Annual leave (HR-LEA-001): employees may take accrued leave during notice, subject to manager agreement; NovaTech may require outstanding leave to be taken during the notice period. Sick leave (HR-LEA-002): standard policies continue to apply; absence must be reported before the working day starts; medical certificate required for absences over 3 consecutive days.

question: What data protection obligations apply to vendors and what happens to customer data when a contract ends?
expected_answer: Vendor acts as Data Processor under GDPR; customer data must be stored in EU-West data centres (VEN-CON-001). On termination: subscriber data exported within 30 days in CSV or JSON; deleted from provider systems within 60 days (VEN-CON-002). Subscriber owns all data generated on the platform.

question: As a new hire joining in January, what annual leave do I accrue and what performance goals must I set?
expected_answer: Annual leave (HR-LEA-001): 20 days per year for the first 2 years; part-time employees receive leave on a pro-rata basis. Performance goals (HR-POL-003): 3 to 5 SMART goals must be agreed with your manager within 30 days of joining, documented in the HRIS system; at least one goal must align to the team's strategic objectives.

question: If credentials are compromised during a security incident, what password and incident response procedures apply?
expected_answer: Incident response Phase 3 — Eradication includes resetting compromised credentials (IT-PROC-003). Shared accounts must store credentials exclusively in Keeper and are audited monthly (IT-PROC-001). Phase 4 — Recovery requires restoring from clean backups and monitoring closely for 72 hours. Post-incident review is mandatory for P1 and P2 incidents with RCA within 5 business days.

question: What are the onboarding requirements from both HR and IT perspectives for a new employee?
expected_answer: HR (HR-POL-002): 90-day onboarding programme with mandatory compliance training in weeks 1 and 4; written contract within 5 business days of verbal offer. IT (IT-PROC-002): employees have no local administrator rights; software deployed centrally via Intune or Jamf; approved software available for self-install via the Self-Service Portal.

question: What recruitment steps are required before a written offer is made, and what goal-setting must follow in the first month?
expected_answer: Recruitment (HR-POL-002): advertise internally for minimum 5 business days; structured panel interview with at least 2 interviewers; notes retained for 12 months; written contract within 5 business days of verbal offer. First month (HR-POL-003): 3-5 SMART goals agreed within 30 days of joining, documented in HRIS; at least one must align to team strategic objectives.

question: If I work remotely and need software for my job, what IT and expense procedures apply?
expected_answer: Software subscriptions are NOT reimbursable as personal purchases under FIN-EXP-002; all software must be requisitioned through IT via IT-PROC-002. Employees should check with IT before purchasing an individual subscription that may already be covered as a team licence. Approved software in the catalogue can be self-installed via the Self-Service Portal.

question: What confidentiality and data obligations remain after a vendor contract ends?
expected_answer: Confidentiality: both parties must maintain confidentiality for 5 years post-termination (VEN-CON-001). Data: subscriber data exported within 30 days in CSV or JSON format; deleted from provider systems within 60 days of the termination request (VEN-CON-002).

question: What is the maximum I can spend on a meal during a business trip?
expected_answer: Depends on context. For personal meals, the dinner per diem cap is USD 60. For client entertainment, amounts above USD 150 per person require VP approval, implying higher amounts are permitted with approval. Alcohol is only claimable as part of client entertainment, not on internal trips.
ambiguity_note: Per diem dinner cap vs client entertainment limit — two valid interpretations depending on whether the meal is solo or with clients

question: When do I need manager or VP approval for expenses?
expected_answer: Travel (FIN-EXP-001): VP approval for business class on international flights over 6 hours; VP approval for client entertainment over USD 150 per person; hotel rates above caps require VP approval prior to booking. Training (FIN-EXP-003): manager approval for training expenses above USD 500; both manager and department head for expenses above USD 1,500.
ambiguity_note: Two separate expense policies define different approval thresholds for different expense types

question: Can I work while on leave?
expected_answer: Depends on leave type. Employees on parental leave may work up to 10 Keeping in Touch (KIT) days with line manager agreement, paid at normal daily rate in addition to parental pay. No general provision for working during annual leave or sick leave is stated in the policies.
ambiguity_note: KIT days apply to parental leave only; the question does not specify leave type, making the answer context-dependent

question: What is the maximum I can spend on home office equipment?
expected_answer: The one-time home office setup allowance is USD 800 total. Within that amount, a desk or office chair is specifically capped at USD 400. Items must be purchased within 90 days of approval and remain NovaTech property upon departure.
ambiguity_note: USD 800 total vs USD 400 cap for desk/chair — the answer depends on which item is being purchased

expected_answer: Different obligations have different durations: subscriber data must be exported within 30 days and deleted within 60 days of the termination request.
